name: quotes-starting
title: Four notes on starting
hint: These are quotes to keep in view, not facts to test: use the quote-card ladder and its long review intervals.
source:
Start before you feel ready; readiness arrives after the first step.
A small thing done today beats a perfect thing planned for next month.
Make the first step so small it is hard to refuse.
Stopping while it still feels easy makes tomorrow's start easier.
